verdict.rationale: Puzzle is a SaaS accounting platform, and whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a public repository, published source code, or an open-source license. The API, MCP integration, data export and llms.txt items concern access and integration, not source openness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
